items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I think that Billy Kyle, Russell Procope, and Charlie with out on the road with Lucky Millinder and his band at the time.

ctx.x: Well that's the information I have from the Encyclopedia of Jazz.

Well, I think that how Babe Russin got in on the gig, Claude must have known him because I knew none of the musicians before I came to New York. You know, I didn't even know Kirby that well and his group. In fact, the first record date that I had used John Kirby's men, he had along with Babe, Pete Brown, alto Man, and Frankie Newton.
